answer: Tie spending power to mutual credit, not identity count. Each agent is a vertex in a trustline graph where peers extend bilateral credit lines they personally back. A fresh agent has zero capacity until genuine counterparties vouch, and a sybil swarm that only lends to itself nets out across the honest cut: the delta of credit actually crossing from real agents is the only throughput it can clear. Spinning up a thousand clones buys nothing, since each still needs a ferrous anchor in the honest core, a voucher who forfeits the credit they extended the moment their referral defaults.
